body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> iRobot announced the iRobot Verro Pool Cleaning Robot during CES 2008.
The iRobot Verro Pool Cleaning Robot is a hands-free, self-contained vacuum cleaning and water filtering robot that gets pools deep-down clean from floor to waterline in about an hour.

The vacuum and self-contained filtration system pick up and trab debris and particles an small as two microns. Reduces run time of pool filtration system. Circulates water; improving distribution of chemicals and temperature.
